text_block_list.text: My first three years with Fenomeno came to a close, welcoming spring once again—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno claims back-to-back Tenno Sho (Spring) titles!
She reigns supreme over a chaotic field, seizing the Spring Shield once again!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~~! Fenomeno, congratulations!
You beat Golshi again this year~~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
Thank you very much, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hold on.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race ain't over yet...!
Don't any of you get it...?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan's on fire!
Give me another 3,200 meters!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're keepin' this up until Golshi-chan wins!!
Uwoooooooogh!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Sto-o-op running right this insta-a-ant!!
Your legs are exha-a-austed!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Next year too... you'll come back for your revenge, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Yes.
—Does it frustrate you that the girl you felt destiny with lost?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If it serves as a good turning point for her,
then that's fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As long as there is an opponent you want to beat,
the flame will never go out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides—
you're happy with this result too, aren't you?
Oops, me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. After all, this too is a brand-new journey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm sure many seek a golden brilliance like that of Orfevre-san or Gold Ship-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yet Fenomeno, who walks a different path
with her earnest and entirely different personality,
has claimed victory just like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Learning that there isn't just one path.
Finding a new path for myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —That, too, is part of the joy of traveling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A travel-lover like you
must already be thrilled with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to seek an even newer,
unknown sense of romance."

Fenomeno and Gold Ship.
Total opposites, the two continued to clash time and time again on the turf.

Every time their fateful clashes occurred,
the crowd went wild. They laughed. They reveled in it.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I get to play Orfevre~!
'We are the strongest in the entire world!'"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll play Gold Ship!
Peace, peace! It's your girl Golshi!"

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
No fair picking first, you two!
I wanna play Orfe too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. They're quite popular, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Boss?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...!
Boss—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Ahaha!
You jest.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't what just happened
suit me perfectly as well?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You needn't worry, something good happened to me as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The other day, when I was
volunteering for intersection patrol—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: There was a child who brought a handmade flag, saying, "I want to help!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she was a girl who used to hesitate
to speak to others, but—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—She was saying she wanted to take action
to protect someone, too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Boss.
If I'm the only one who stands out
and becomes the children's idol—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—A world like that
would be totally boring, sir!!
(*whistle*...... *drip*)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A branch...?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry!
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
This kid was copying Orfe,
chucking her staff with a whoosh~.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Do you realize how dangerous that was?
Swinging around a long object like that could hurt someone.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: So long as you understand.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
! ...You're not mad anymore?
That's it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Hate the sin, not the sinner.
You'll be careful from now on, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Allies of justice
do not exist simply to be angry.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—I exist to protect a future
where tomorrow can be even more joyful.

Black and white. The model and the lawless.
Serious and frivolous.

Though the two are completely unalike,
to speak of one is to summon the other.

"It is surely because
the destiny the two of them carved out
was such a joyful one."
Because you showed me so many different paths, never letting me be confined to just one single perspective.
The golden rival is—

Protecting the path the children behind walk
and making it fun, two sides of the same coin—
a golden hero of justice.
"CASE: Hope"
